cards.text: Welcome to the bakery, friend. We're in the book of Judges, where the Israelites are living among the peoples of Canaan and marrying into their families (Judges 3:5-6). And now they do evil in the sight of the LORD and forget the LORD their God.

cards.question: Israel forgets the LORD their God. What do they do instead?

answers.text: They serve the Baals and the Asherahs
They stop worshiping anything at all
They head back down to Egypt

cards.text: The anger of the LORD burns against Israel, and He sells them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim, king of Aram-naharaim.

cards.question: The LORD sells Israel into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim. What does that mean for Israel?

answers.text: They serve him for eight years
They drive him out right away

cards.question: True or false: after eight years under Cushan-rishathaim, the Israelites cry out to the LORD.

cards.text: The LORD raises up a deliverer to save them: Othniel, son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.
The Spirit of the LORD comes upon Othniel, and he becomes Israel's judge and goes out to war.

cards.question: The LORD delivers Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram into Othniel's hand, and Othniel ___ against him.
True or false: after Othniel's victory, the land's rest ends while Othniel is still alive.

cards.text: Forty years of rest, until Othniel dies, and then once again the Israelites do evil in the sight of the LORD. That's me and the snooze button, friend: every morning I swear I'm DONE with it, and every morning, SLAP, there goes my mustache.

cards.question: Israel is right back to doing evil in the sight of the LORD. What does the LORD do this time?

answers.text: He gives a foreign king power over Israel
He gives them forty more years of rest
He lets it pass without a word

cards.text: This time it's Eglon king of Moab, and he brings backup: the Ammonites AND the Amalekites. Together they attack and defeat Israel, and Eglon takes possession of the City of Palms.

cards.question: Israel serves Eglon king of Moab for ___ years.

cards.text: Again they cry out to the LORD, and He raises up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer. Hang on to that left-handed part, friend, because me, I'm mustache-handed, and nobody EVER writes that down.

cards.question: True or false: the Israelites send Ehud to Eglon king of Moab carrying tribute.

cards.text: But Ehud has also made himself a double-edged sword, a cubit long, and he hides it under his cloak. Tribute on its way, sword under his cloak, friend, this is NOT a regular delivery.

cards.question: Remember, Ehud is left-handed. Where does he strap his sword under his cloak?

cards.text: Ehud brings the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was an obese man. Once the tribute is presented, Ehud sends off the men who carried it.
Ehud has left Eglon king of Moab behind. But near the idols at Gilgal, Ehud himself turns back.

cards.question: Ehud walks back in to King Eglon by himself. What does he tell the king?

answers.text: I have a secret message for you
I have more tribute for you
I have come to make peace

cards.text: The king says, "Silence," and all his attendants walk out. Friend, I've never cleared a room that fast, and I once burned a batch so bad the smoke alarm filed a complaint.

cards.question: Ehud approaches Eglon, sitting alone in his cool upper room, and says he has a word from God for him. True or false: the king stays in his seat.

cards.text: The king rises, and Ehud reaches with his left hand, pulls the sword from his right thigh, and plunges it into Eglon's belly.
Even the handle sinks in after the blade, and Eglon's fat closes over it, so Ehud leaves the sword where it is. And Eglon's bowels empty.

cards.question: Then Ehud goes out through the porch, closing and ___ the doors of the upper room behind him.

cards.text: Once Ehud is gone, Eglon's servants come in and find the doors of the upper room locked.

cards.question: The doors of the upper room are locked. What do Eglon's servants figure the king is doing in there?

answers.text: Relieving himself in the cool room
Resting up in the cool room

cards.text: So they wait until they get worried, and the doors still haven't opened. You know this one, friend: standing outside a door, checking your phone, nobody brave enough to knock.

cards.question: Finally the servants take the ___ and open the doors, and there's their lord, lying dead on the floor.
True or false: Ehud gets away while Eglon's servants are still waiting outside the doors.

cards.text: Eglon king of Moab is dead, and Ehud arrives in Seirah. Now it's time to call Israel together.

cards.question: In Seirah, how does Ehud call the Israelites to him?

answers.text: He sends runners to the tribes

cards.text: The horn sounds throughout the hill country of Ephraim, the Israelites come down from the hills with him, and Ehud becomes their leader. Friend, when I make a big announcement on my cookie planet, the only one who shows up is my echo.

cards.question: Ehud tells the Israelites to follow him. True or false: he tells them the LORD has delivered the Moabites into their hand.

cards.text: So they follow him down and seize the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab.

cards.question: Israel is holding the river crossings that lead to Moab. What do they do there?

cards.text: At that time they strike down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men. Not one of them escapes.

cards.question: That day, Moab is subdued under the hand of Israel, and the land has rest for ___ years.

cards.text: After Ehud comes Shamgar son of Anath, and he too saves Israel.

cards.question: Shamgar strikes down six hundred Philistines. What does he use?
